canaanite.title: Canaanite
canaanite.note: They were the people living in the land promised to Israel. The biblical genealogy traces them to Canaan, son of Ham. The Old Testament repeatedly orders them driven out because of their idol worship and other practices.

lemuel.title: Lemuel
lemuel.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
lemuel.note: Proverbs 31 opens with what his mother taught him, to stay off wine and stand up for the poor and needy. Which kingdom he ruled nobody knows. Later Jewish tradition sometimes made him Solomon under another name, but that cannot be confirmed.
